parameters.query:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb)
    AS x(campus text, week_of text, day_name text, menu_date text, category text, subcategory text,
         dish_name text, allergens text, calories integer, protein numeric, fat numeric, sodium numeric)
), del AS (
  DELETE FROM menu_items
   WHERE campus = 'Uzumasa' AND category = 'Halal'
     AND menu_date IN (SELECT DISTINCT menu_date FROM src)
)
INSERT INTO menu_items
  (campus, week_of, day_name, menu_date, category, subcategory, dish_name, allergens, calories, protein, fat, sodium)
SELECT campus, week_of, day_name, menu_date, category, subcategory, dish_name, allergens, calories, protein, fat, sodium
  FROM src
ON CONFLICT (campus, menu_date, dish_name, subcategory) DO UPDATE SET
  week_of   = EXCLUDED.week_of,
  day_name  = EXCLUDED.day_name,
  category  = EXCLUDED.category,
  allergens = EXCLUDED.allergens,
  calories  = EXCLUDED.calories,
  protein   = EXCLUDED.protein,
  fat       = EXCLUDED.fat,
  sodium    = EXCLUDED.sodium
